text: Small patchsets can still carry important contracts: Bob17 remote job dependency was about 28K and added docs, fixtures, provider shim, and tests without queuebash runtime edits.

Bob19 AI broker health-cache fallback has real files but a manifest shape without entries/files; merge-plan reports unsupported shape, so reconcile files/diffs manually and preserve help text through display resources.
When display-help extraction moves queue ai help to resources, later help-text patches should update resources.d/display/*/ai-help.txt rather than reintroducing heredocs into queuebash.sh.
